title: Wila Jaljañ Ola
intro: Uraq patjjar mä jachʼa uma jalsu, mä Arcajj jan saytʼas jalnaqki ukat mä almajj ajllisaw anqan jaytatäski uk amuytʼañäni. Wilampiw mä profetar chint’ata, ukampirus iyawsäwimp jaljata, uka jaqix qhip qhipa jawsañampiw uñjasïna, umax walpun jalsuwayxäna. ¿Khitis uka jan iyawsäwin qhepäjjat utji uk qhanañchtʼasmati?
clues: Nayax Allahan jach’a profetanakapat maynïrin wawapätwa, mä iyawsäwin utap jaytañatakiw ajlliwayta.
Jachʼa Uma Juicio tiempon jakayäta, uka tiemponjja jan creyiñajj umar uñtataw oraqer chʼamaktʼayäna.
Awkijajj jawsanitäna ukhajj janiw creyentenakamp chika Arcar makatañ munkayätti.
Uma taypit jarkʼaqasiñatakiw mä qollun imantasiñ thaqä sasaw sista.
Nayax sapxituwa, janiw kunas uka urux Allahan kamachipat jark’aqkaspati, jan ukasti khuyapayasiñakiw jark’aqaspa.
Nayajj oladanakan katjataw uñjasta ukat umamp jaqsutätwa, ukat awkijarojj janiw cheqapar sarnaqer familiapat jutirïkti sasaw sapjjetäna.

identity.label: ¿Khitis nayajja?
options: Zayd ibn Harithah sat jilataw ukham luräna
Ishaq profeta, Ibrahim profetan yuqapa
Nuh profetan jan iyawsiri Yuqapa
Habil, Adán profetan Yuqapa
Ismail profeta, Ibrahim profetan Yuqapa

arknaqatäñat qhespiyañatakejj walja patak maranakaw mä pʼiyan ikirïna
trial.answer: Arcar jan mantañ munasa ukat imantasir mä qollu thaqhasa

location.answer: Uka jachʼa qollujj Uma Juiciot imantasiñwa thaqäna

outcome.label: Utjiri
options: Jachʼa jachʼa tukuñatakejj tesoronakampi oraqen manqʼantatawa
Thayanakaru ukat jinninakar ch’amampi mä reino churata
Thaya ukat jan kuna jan walt’äwin lurata kunjamatix ninax sumankañar tukuwayki ukhama
Alaxpachar jaktayatäxänwa ukat chʼakkatatäñat qhispiyatäxänwa
Uma Juicioruw umamp chhaqhayata ukat janiw aski familiat jutirïkti sasaw yatiyapxi
outcome.answer: Uma Juicioruw umamp chhaqhayata ukat janiw aski familiat jutirïkti sasaw yatiyapxi

arabic: وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌۭ رَّبَّهُۥ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ ٱبْنِى مِنْ أَهْلِى وَإِنَّ وَعْدَكَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنتَ أَحْكَمُ ٱلْحَـٰكِمِينَ
verse: And Noah called to his Lord and said, "My Lord, indeed my son is of my family; and indeed, Your promise is true; and You are the most just of judges!" (11:45)
